description: An agent-based model simulating the spread of a virus in a population of 1000 people, capturing individual interactions and infection dynamics.

behaviors.name: move
behaviors.description: Simulates random movement of a person within the environment.
behaviors.algorithm: Randomly change position within the movement range in each time step.

behaviors.name: interact
behaviors.description: Simulates interaction between people that can lead to virus transmission.
behaviors.algorithm: Check for proximity with other agents and execute interaction.

behaviors.name: get_infected
behaviors.description: Changes health status to infected based on interaction with another infected person.
behaviors.algorithm: If interacting with an infected individual, change status to infected with a probability of infection_probability.

behaviors.name: recover
behaviors.description: Simulates recovery from infection after a specified recovery time.
behaviors.algorithm: Change health status to recovered after recovery_time days.

interactions.name: virus_transmission
interactions.description: Transmission of the virus from one person to another through interaction.
interactions.effect: The susceptible person may become infected.

algorithms.infection_algorithm: Implement virus transmission based on proximity and probability.
algorithms.movement_algorithm: Utilize random movement pattern within grid constraints.

files.name: entities.py
files.description: Definition of Person and related attributes and behaviors.

files.name: environment.py
files.description: Setup and management of the simulation environment.

files.name: metrics.py
files.description: Calculation and tracking of simulation metrics.
